# InternshipCRM Accessibility Conformance Report

## International Edition — VPAT® 2.5 INT (International Edition), ITI

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/vpat-evidence.mjs from src/lib/vpat.ts — do not edit by hand. Regenerate: npm run vpat:evidence -->

**Name of Product/Version:** InternshipCRM — the web application (public pages, sign-in, mentee, mentor, admin and company areas). The deployed version and commit are printed on /release-notes and returned by GET /api/health; the automated evidence below names the commit the baseline was last changed at.

**Report Date:** 2026-10-27

**Product Description:** A web application for running structured programmes between people and organisations — profiles, matching, a pipeline board, messaging, meetings, documents and reporting — served from a Next.js deployment and used in a browser on desktop and phone.

**Contact Information:** The feedback channel (operator e-mail, response target and escalation route) is published on /accessibility; the public issue tracker is the second channel.

**Notes:** Self-assessment by the maintainers; no third-party audit has been commissioned. Conformance is claimed only for the product's own user interface: files users upload, e-mail as rendered by a mail client and the two embedded third parties (the Jitsi meeting room, the marketing-cookie-gated live chat on the home page) are out of scope and listed as known limitations on /accessibility.

**Evaluation Methods Used:**

- Automated: an axe-core scan (`@axe-core/playwright`) with the WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA rule sets over every page state in `e2e/a11y-baseline.json`, each in light and dark mode, in five role contexts (public, mentee, mentor, admin, company). Critical and serious findings fail every pull request (`.github/workflows/e2e.yml`); the per-page result is the appendix generated by `npm run vpat:evidence`.
- Targeted mechanical checks written against single criteria: contrast of specific components in both themes (`e2e/contrast-*.spec.ts`, `e2e/helpers/hoverContrast.ts`), keyboard operation of the pipeline board, the global search combobox and the calendar (`e2e/board-a11y.spec.ts`, `e2e/global-search-a11y.spec.ts`, `e2e/calendar-a11y-2153.spec.ts`), the skip link (`e2e/a11y.spec.ts`), text resize and 320 px / 400 % reflow (`e2e/font-size.spec.ts`, `e2e/mobile-layout-audit.spec.ts`), and the OS preferences reduced motion, more contrast and forced colours (`e2e/a11y-media-preferences.spec.ts`).
- Manual: no structured screen-reader or keyboard test programme has been run yet. Every row whose only basis would be the authors' own use is marked Partially Supports and names the tracking issue, so this report does not imply coverage it does not have.
- Scope of the evaluated URLs: exactly the page states listed in the appendix. The rest of the product follows the same components and conventions but is pending evaluation.

The evaluated URL set is exactly: `/`, `/auth/signin`, `/accessibility`, `/apply/:mentorId`, `/portal`, `/portal/journey`, `/portal/goals`, `/portal/calendar`, `/account`, `/portal/requests`, `/portal/profile`, `/portal/projects`, `/portal/interactions`, `/portal/notes`, `/mentor`, `/mentor/mentees`, `/admin`, `/admin/candidates`, `/messages`, `/notifications`, `/mentor/board`, `/admin/board`, `/admin/companies/:id`, `/admin/settings`, `/company` — each in light and dark mode (50 page states), at commit `b65ca8e` (2026-10-21), rule set `wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa`, with 0 open critical/serious finding(s) frozen in the baseline. **Every other URL of the product is pending evaluation.** The per-page result is in the [evidence appendix](vpat-evidence.md).

## Terms

The terms used in the Conformance Level information are defined as follows:

- **Supports:** The functionality of the product has at least one method that meets the criterion without known defects or meets with equivalent facilitation.
- **Partially Supports:** Some functionality of the product does not meet the criterion.
- **Does Not Support:** The majority of product functionality does not meet the criterion.
- **Not Applicable:** The criterion is not relevant to the product.

Every row carries an **Evidence** column: the file in this repository whose behaviour the remark describes, the test that pins it, or the issue that tracks the gap. A row says *Supports* only when that column is not empty — that rule is enforced by `scripts/test/vpat.test.mjs`. Rows that cite [#2864](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/issues/2864) are the ones a manual test programme or a fix would move; the self-assessment story is [#2033](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/issues/2033).

### Chapter 10: Non-web Documents

The product's interface is web content (chapter 9). The documents it produces itself are the certificate PDF and CSV/ICS exports; documents people upload (CVs, attachments) are their own.

| Criteria | Conformance Level | Remarks and Explanations | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **10** Non-web documents produced by the product | Partially Supports | CSV and ICS exports are plain structured text. The certificate PDF is generated from structured data but its tagging, reading order and language metadata have not been evaluated. Tracked in #2864. | [`src/lib/certificatePdf.ts`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/src/lib/certificatePdf.ts) · [#2864](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/issues/2864) |

### Chapter 11: Software

A web application: clauses 11.1 to 11.4 are covered by chapter 9 and are not repeated. The clauses that apply to the application as software are below.

| Criteria | Conformance Level | Remarks and Explanations | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **11.5.2** Interoperability with assistive technology (accessibility services) | Supports | The product exposes semantics through HTML and WAI-ARIA to the browser's platform accessibility API; it ships no custom accessibility service and bypasses none. | [`e2e/a11y-baseline.json`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/e2e/a11y-baseline.json) · [`src/components/ui/LiveRegion.tsx`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/src/components/ui/LiveRegion.tsx) |
| **11.6.1** User control of accessibility features | Supports | Text size and theme are ordinary settings; OS preferences are applied automatically (5.2). | [`src/components/FontSizeControl.tsx`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/src/components/FontSizeControl.tsx) · [`e2e/a11y-media-preferences.spec.ts`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/e2e/a11y-media-preferences.spec.ts) |
| **11.6.2** No disruption of accessibility features | Supports | Reduced motion, more contrast and forced colours from the platform are honoured, not overridden; no key or gesture of the assistive technology is intercepted. | [`e2e/a11y-media-preferences.spec.ts`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/e2e/a11y-media-preferences.spec.ts) · [`src/lib/shortcuts.ts`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/src/lib/shortcuts.ts) |
| **11.7** User preferences | Supports | Colour scheme, contrast, motion and forced colours follow the platform settings; the in-app text size adds to the browser's own zoom. | [`e2e/a11y-media-preferences.spec.ts`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/e2e/a11y-media-preferences.spec.ts) · [`e2e/dark-mode.spec.ts`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/e2e/dark-mode.spec.ts) |
| **11.8.1** Authoring tool — content technology | Supports | What people author (messages, notes, announcements, goals) is stored as text and rendered as HTML; images are attached as files. | [`src/components/MessageThreadView.tsx`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/src/components/MessageThreadView.tsx) |
| **11.8.2** Authoring tool — accessible content creation | Partially Supports | Text content is accessible by construction; an attached image takes no alternative text and the composer gives no prompt for one. Tracked in #2864. | [`src/components/MessageThreadView.tsx`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/main/src/components/MessageThreadView.tsx) · [#2864](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/issues/2864) |
| **11.8.3** Authoring tool — preservation of accessibility information in transformations | Not Applicable | No transformation of authored content between formats, other than the PDF covered in 5.4. | — |
| **11.8.4** Authoring tool — repair assistance | Does Not Support | No accessibility checking or repair assistance is offered to authors. Tracked in #2864. | [#2864](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/issues/2864) |
| **11.8.5** Authoring tool — templates | Partially Supports | Document templates an administrator provides are rendered through the same accessible interface; their own accessibility is the author's. Tracked in #2864. | [#2864](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/issues/2864) |
